messages.subject: ERROR: cannot open the connection
parts:
Hi, I have a simple R-language script which eventually calls and blocks at runApp(). Everything works great for about 12 hours whilst I periodically refresh my browser to test the connection, then I start to receive:

"ERROR: cannot open the connection"

and no further connections are possible. Any ideas what the issue could be?

Thanks.

messages.author: 6d1611ed314426cb
messages.subject: Re: ERROR: cannot open the connection
parts: I've now discovered that something is deleting/tidying-up the R-session temporary directory after 10/12 hours. Not sure why however.
